title: Translucent, a health care finance startup that helps hospitals improve cash management, raised a $27M Series A led by GV, after a $7M seed in August 2024 (Allie Garfinkle/Fortune)
summary: Allie Garfinkle / Fortune: Translucent, a health care finance startup that helps hospitals improve cash management, raised a $27M Series A led by GV, after a $7M seed in August 2024 — Senior Finance Reporter And Author Of Term Sheet — Jack O'Hara has seen a hospital shut down. — It happens via blurry paperwork and running out of time.
contentText:
Allie Garfinkle / Fortune :

Translucent, a health care finance startup that helps hospitals improve cash management, raised a $27M Series A led by GV, after a $7M seed in August 2024   —  Senior Finance Reporter And Author Of Term Sheet  —  Jack O'Hara has seen a hospital shut down.  —  It happens via blurry paperwork and running out of time.
